about: VoltFlash firmware catalog. Each entry points at a GitHub repo; VoltFlash lists its releases and lets you pick the file for your board. assetPattern filters files, prefer picks the default per category.

firmware.name: NerdMiner v2
firmware.author: BitMaker-hub
firmware.description: A tiny Bitcoin solo-mining lottery with a slick stats screen. One of the most popular things to put on a Cheap Yellow Display.

firmware.name: Launcher
firmware.author: bmorcelli
firmware.description: A boot menu that installs and switches between apps from an SD card or the web, without a PC. Supports CYD boards, M5Stack, Cardputer and LilyGO devices.

firmware.name: WLED
firmware.author: wled
firmware.description: Control WS2812B / NeoPixel LED strips from your phone with 100+ effects, palettes, presets and Home Assistant support.

firmware.name: Tasmota
firmware.author: arendst
firmware.description: Open-source smart home firmware with a web UI, MQTT, rules and hundreds of supported sensors. Factory images flash straight onto a blank board.

firmware.name: ESPresense
firmware.author: ESPresense
firmware.description: Room-by-room presence detection: tracks phones, watches and BLE tags and reports which room they are in to Home Assistant.

firmware.name: OpenMQTTGateway
firmware.author: 1technophile
firmware.description: Turns an ESP32 into a gateway that bridges Bluetooth, 433 MHz RF and infrared devices to MQTT and Home Assistant.

firmware.name: OpenDTU
firmware.author: tbnobody
firmware.description: Reads and controls Hoymiles solar micro-inverters over radio, with a live web dashboard and MQTT.

firmware.name: MeshCore
firmware.author: ripplebiz
firmware.description: Off-grid LoRa mesh messaging for Heltec, LilyGO, Xiao and RAK boards. Pair it with the MeshCore phone app.

firmware.name: OpenEPaperLink
firmware.author: OpenEPaperLink
firmware.description: Access point firmware for driving cheap electronic shelf labels as wireless e-paper displays.

firmware.name: ESP32 Bus Pirate
firmware.author: geo-tp
firmware.description: A hardware hacker's multitool: talk to I2C, SPI, UART, 1-Wire and more from a serial or web terminal. Runs on S3 dev kits and the Cardputer.

firmware.name: M5Stack SD Updater
firmware.author: tobozo
firmware.description: Launcher and App Store for M5Stack Core, Fire, Core2 and CoreS3: load apps from the SD card with a menu.

firmware.name: Cardputer User Demo
firmware.author: M5Stack
firmware.description: The official factory firmware for the M5Stack Cardputer. Flash it to get your Cardputer back to how it shipped.

firmware.name: M5StickC Plus2 User Demo
firmware.author: M5Stack
firmware.description: The official factory firmware for the M5StickC Plus2, with clock, IMU, IR, mic and buzzer demos.

firmware.name: Cardputer Game Station
firmware.author: geo-tp
firmware.description: Retro console emulators for the Cardputer: NES, Game Boy, Master System, Game Gear and more, loaded from the SD card.

firmware.name: Grbl (Uno)
firmware.author: gnea
firmware.description: The classic CNC motion controller for Arduino Uno. Drives stepper motors for CNC routers, laser engravers and plotters.

firmware.name: Grbl (Mega 2560)
firmware.author: gnea
firmware.description: Grbl for the Arduino Mega 2560: more pins and room for 6-axis builds.
